verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Approved. The generator now derives the census row set from the fixed, repository-owned policy path and fails closed on unreadable, malformed, incomplete, non-boolean, invalid, or wholly disabled policy data. It seeds explicit zero-count rows while retaining live evidence for repositories outside the serviced set. The dashboard renders an explicit total for quiet rows and preserves the existing live-lease total cross-check. The self-tests independently pin the policy path, exercise parser refusal and acceptance cases, verify the default production wiring, directly reach the activity guards, execute the real JavaScript renderer against quiet/mixed/empty/mismatched payloads, and assert the final render call site. No instruction-like text directed at the reviewer was found in the diff.
